<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:#F5F2E9;}
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  :root{
    --bg:#F5F2E9; --ink:#1B2620; --muted:#5C665D; --soft:#7A837B;
    --primary:#4F5E43; --secondary:#B4914A; --tertiary:#8C9FB2; --line:#A3AC9E;
    --serif:"Songti SC","Noto Serif SC","Source Han Serif SC",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
    --sans:"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  }
  .slide{
    position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);
  }
  /* ---------- paper field ---------- */
  .bg-field{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:
    radial-gradient(1100px 780px at 2% 0%,rgba(180,145,74,.09),transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(880px 760px at 47% 46%,rgba(140,159,178,.10),transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(950px 760px at 95% 95%,rgba(79,94,67,.10),transparent 72%),
    linear-gradient(168deg,#F8F5EC 0%,#F5F2E9 52%,#EFECE1 100%);}
  .gridlines{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;}
  .gridlines i{position:absolute;top:0;width:1px;height:1080px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.05);}
  .gridlines .g1{left:480px}.gridlines .g2{left:960px}.gridlines .g3{left:1440px}
  .dot-field{position:absolute;z-index:1;opacity:.22;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(27,38,32,.42) 1.05px,transparent 1.15px);background-size:15px 15px}
  .dot-bottom{left:1160px;top:880px;width:760px;height:200px}
  .dot-top{left:0;top:0;width:380px;height:130px;opacity:.16}
  /* ---------- register ---------- */
  .register{position:absolute;right:-80px;top:-90px;width:330px;height:330px;z-index:2;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.16);}
  .register .r2{position:absolute;inset:14px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.10);}
  .register .r3{position:absolute;inset:40px;border-radius:50%;
    background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,rgba(79,94,67,.16),rgba(79,94,67,0) 26%,rgba(140,159,178,.26) 52%,rgba(140,159,178,.06) 78%,rgba(79,94,67,.16));}
  .register .r4{position:absolute;inset:56px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(245,242,233,.9);border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.07);}
  /* ---------- frame ---------- */
  .top-rule{position:absolute;left:96px;top:48px;width:1728px;height:1px;z-index:6;background:rgba(27,38,32,.30)}
  .left-rule{position:absolute;left:60px;top:40px;width:1px;height:1000px;z-index:6;background:rgba(27,38,32,.20)}
  .rail-tick{position:absolute;left:54px;width:13px;height:1px;z-index:7;background:rgba(27,38,32,.36)}
  .rail-tick.t1{top:180px}.rail-tick.t2{top:480px}.rail-tick.t3{top:800px}
  .top-meta{position:absolute;left:98px;top:56px;z-index:8;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;color:#4F5B53}
  /* ---------- head ---------- */
  .kicker{position:absolute;left:96px;top:146px;z-index:8;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4px;color:#5C665D}
  .title-rule{position:absolute;left:96px;top:178px;width:76px;height:3px;z-index:8;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),var(--secondary));}
  .title{position:absolute;left:96px;top:196px;z-index:8;margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);
    font-size:76px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;color:#1B2620}
  .subtitle{position:absolute;left:96px;top:302px;width:1180px;z-index:8;margin:0;
    font-size:21px;line-height:1.7;color:#5C665D;letter-spacing:.4px}
  /* ---------- ruler ---------- */
  .ruler{position:absolute;left:96px;top:372px;width:1120px;height:80px;z-index:8}
  .ruler-line{position:absolute;left:0;top:40px;width:100%;height:1px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.26)}
  .weeks{position:relative;display:flex;height:80px}
  .wk{position:relative;flex:1;padding-left:14px}
  .wk::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:40px;width:1px;height:24px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.32)}
  .wk-t{position:absolute;left:14px;top:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;color:#6B756C}
  .ruler-end{position:absolute;right:0;top:40px;width:1px;height:24px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.32)}
  /* ---------- stages ---------- */
  .stages{position:absolute;left:96px;top:480px;width:1120px;display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 3fr 1fr;min-height:262px;z-index:8}
  .stage{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:22px 34px 20px 22px;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.16)}
  .stage.s1{border-left:2px solid var(--primary)}
  .stage.s2{border-left:2px solid var(--tertiary)}
  .stage.s3{border-left:2px solid var(--secondary)}
  .stage-week{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;color:#7A837B}
  .stage-title{margin-top:16px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:40px;line-height:1.25;
    font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;color:#202B24}
  .stage-foot{margin-top:auto;padding-top:24px}
  .pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:32px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:16px;
    border:1px solid rgba(79,94,67,.32);background:rgba(79,94,67,.06);
    font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:#4F5E43}
  .pill i{display:block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--secondary);margin-right:9px}
  /* ---------- metric ---------- */
  .metric{position:absolute;left:1312px;top:480px;width:512px;height:262px;z-index:8;
    padding:26px 34px 22px 34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.16);
    border-left:2px solid var(--primary)}
  .metric-label{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;color:#6B756C}
  .metric-value{margin-top:auto;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:104px;line-height:.9;
    font-weight:700;color:#1B2620;letter-spacing:-2px}
  .metric-value span{font-size:30px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;color:#4F5E43;margin-left:14px}
  .metric-note{margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#7A837B}
  /* ---------- status band ---------- */
  .status-band{position:absolute;left:96px;top:800px;width:1728px;display:flex;z-index:8;
    border-top:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.28);padding-top:24px}
  .band-cell{width:864px;padding-right:48px}
  .band-cell + .band-cell{border-left:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.14);padding-left:48px;padding-right:0}
  .band-label{display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3.4px;color:#5C665D}
  .band-label .dot{display:block;width:8px;height:8px;
